svg.text: TRACE-VL v2 — streaming video understanding with transition evidence memory
A pretrained VLM answers from evidence chosen under a fixed visual-token budget; the memory stores where the scene changed, before/after crops and when
1 Observe — causal, question-independent (one pass per stream, CPU)
slow bg frozen inside active regions
images sized to the token grid
Example of packed evidence (what the VLM sees, in order)
“Fixed security camera, current time 12:30. The red box marks the area the question is about.”
“Change 1: inside the red box; appeared at 08:12 (4 min 18 s ago); changed back at 10:40 (1 min 50 s ago).”
… more changes until the budget is spent …
Q: In the last 10 minutes, did someone put down an object
inside the red box and later pick it up again?
A. Yes B. No — Answer with the option letter only.
3 Compared at the same visual-token budget (same VLM, same current frame)
First benchmark: MEVA fixed-camera long-gap questions (placed-and-removed, duration, count; still-there control). Requires a fixed camera. Not yet run on GPU — no results.
